# Desktop artwork sources and notices

The numbered launcher icons and wallpaper in the classic Desktop were captured from a Linux desktop.
The manifest maps each captured path to its original artwork, source archive or tagged source file, and
copyright notices. The source directory retains the upstream artwork identified in that review. Package
and upstream notices apply to their respective artwork. The application icons identify those applications.

The capture used GTK to render or scale the images. Two installed SVGs were optimized by the distro
before capture. The manifest records the identified rendering steps. With the recovered Onboard SVG,
pixel differences are confined to rendering the O and B glyphs.

This material records the attribution for the captured Desktop assets.
